english.title: Parish/community council candidate pay sum or incur election expenses
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were guilty of an illegal practice in that, being a

(A)_[candidate]_
(B)_[person on behalf of a candidate, namely **(..SPECIFY CANDIDATE..),]_

at an election under the Local Government Act 1972 which was not a local government election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..), you knowingly

(C)_[paid a sum,]_
(D)_[incurred an expense,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY SUM OR EXPENSE..), before, during or after that election, on account of or in respect of the conduct or management of the election
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 90(2) and 169 of the Representation of the People Act 1983.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex see section 176Note
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
